doc: A key the designer does not know, and a cell whose number does not read, are kept byte for byte through every edit around them: the unknown keys of a view and a row stay, the cell is reported as an unreadable entry, produces no element and is never rewritten. An unknown key inside a removed entry goes with the entry, and comes back with the undo.

steps.doc: Opening and saving without an edit writes the bytes that were read.
A cell's number is replaced; the unknown key of its row, two lines below, stays as it is.
steps.expect:
ded: "0.1"
designer: etalii/knowledge
name: Cities
properties:
  - id: p1
    name: Name
    type: text
    title: true
  - id: p3
    name: Population
    type: number
views:
  - id: v1
    name: All cities
    density: compact   # a setting this version does not know
rows:
  - id: r1
    cells:
      - property: p1
        text: Amsterdam
      - property: p3
        number: 931300
    source: census 2024   # not modelled, kept
  - id: r2
    cells:
      - property: p1
        text: Antwerp
      - property: p3
        number: about half a million
